segments.title: 第139章 唱給一個人的歌
segments.content:
Chapter 139 A Song Sung for One Person

"Only by turning on your own"

"Can you be bathed in light"

"The sun is always there"

As the song reached the chorus, Li Luo's voice suddenly soared.

The powerful melody instantly captured everyone's ears, invigorating their spirits.

A faint light glimmered in Ying Chanxi's eyes as she stared intently at Li Luo on the rostrum, his voice echoing in her ears.

"I wish everyone a happy sports meet. May you show your style on the track, and I also hope that on the path of your own lives, you can go wherever your heart desires."

During the instrumental interlude, Li Luo smiled and offered his blessings, "I have a friend who is about to run the 1500-meter race, and she said she was a little nervous beforehand. I hope this song can give you strength too."

After saying this, Li Luo went into the next verse of the song, which slowly came to an end amidst the lingering resonance of the guitar.

"I don't think I've ever heard this song before." Seeing that he had finished singing, Xu Youyu couldn't help but ask curiously, "Don't tell me you wrote this one yourself too?"

"What else could it be." Li Luo returned the microphone to the two hosts and put his guitar back backstage.

"I really don't know how your brain works." Xu Youyu clicked her tongue in amazement, still finding it incredible. "You didn't write this on the spot just to cheer for Xixi, did you?"

"You really think too highly of me..."

Posturing was one thing, but he still had to follow the basic laws of reality.

For someone like him who had barely studied music theory, being able to write songs was already defying nature. He still had to rely on Yan Zhusheng just to write out the musical score.

If people thought he could write songs on the spot, it would be a bit too much of an exaggeration. Li Luo felt it was better to be a little more low-key.

"So you've already written three songs now." Xu Youyu remarked with a sigh, "That's also very impressive."

"Yeah, three songs..." As Li Luo said this, his expression suddenly froze. "Senior, how did you know it was three? Have you heard 'The Light Chaser'?"

"Huh?" Xu Youyu was also stunned for a moment. A cold sweat broke out as she stammered and nodded, "Ye-yeah, I've heard it. 'The Light Chaser'."

In reality, she had never heard "The Light Chaser" at all. Besides having sung it for Yan Zhusheng and Ying Chanxi, he had only performed it once in the stands for Class 8.

Li Luo didn't know if Xu Youyu had happened to pass by at that time and heard it.

Xu Youyu, on the other hand, had included "Annual Rings" in her count and had accidentally let it slip.

But from Li Luo's perspective, only Yan Zhusheng knew the specifics of the song "Annual Rings." Neither Xu Youyu nor Ying Chanxi should have known about it.

By a stroke of luck, their brainwaves barely aligned, and neither of them gave anything away.

Seeing that Li Luo hadn't noticed anything, Xu Youyu relaxed a little, then said, "Xixi is already lining up for the 1500-meter race over there. You should hurry up and go see her."

Li Luo followed the direction Xu Youyu was pointing and could already see Ying Chanxi's figure in the distance.

So he didn't linger on the rostrum. After bidding farewell to Xu Youyu, he jumped off and trotted over toward Ying Chanxi.

At this moment, a smile played on Ying Chanxi's lips, and her steps were a little lighter than usual. Walking on the grass felt like walking on soft clouds; she felt as light as a feather, floating in the sky.

At first, everyone thought that Li Luo was singing this song for all the students in the school.

But later they realized that this song was specially sung for that friend Li Luo mentioned.

And Ying Chanxi knew very well who that person was.

Immersed in such joy, she completely forgot her nervousness about the upcoming 1500-meter race.

She didn't even notice when Li Luo had walked up beside her.

"What are you grinning foolishly about?" Li Luo tapped Ying Chanxi on the head and said with a laugh, "Can't you even see a big living person standing right here?"

"Ugh..." Ying Chanxi clutched her head and turned to glare at Li Luo. "You walk without making a sound. Are you trying to scare me to death?"

"You just didn't notice." Li Luo reached out and took the staff ID badge from her neck. "Let me hold this for you."

"Hmph, you know what's good for you." Ying Chanxi let him take her badge, then, as if remembering something, looked at Qiao Xinyan who had accompanied her. "Xinyan, take a picture for me."

Saying that, she pulled Li Luo over, held up a peace sign with the rostrum as the background.

Li Luo himself was indifferent to having his picture taken, but he cooperated and struck a pose.

After taking the picture with Li Luo, Ying Chanxi handed the Polaroid to him and then took a picture with Qiao Xinyan and Jin Yuting, who was also participating in the race.

It was a simple memento.

There were no preliminaries or finals for the 1500-meter race. Under the teacher's instruction, more than thirty first-year girls all squeezed onto a single starting line.

Li Luo looked at Ying Chanxi among them and shouted words of encouragement.

But the next second, the teacher gave the "Ready, set, go!" command, which made Ying Chanxi freeze for a moment. Only after everyone around her had dashed out did she belatedly hurry to catch up.

Li Luo's heart tightened. He immediately started running alongside Ying Chanxi on the grass, saying as he ran, "The 1500 is a battle of endurance. Leading at the start is useless. The key is to maintain your own rhythm and pace, and manage your stamina."

Ying Chanxi nodded silently, keeping up with the group in front of her. Following Li Luo's advice, she didn't rush, maintaining a position in the third tier at the beginning.

However, the actual skill level of the students from each class participating in the 1500-meter race varied greatly.

Someone like Jin Yuting, who was purely there to make up the numbers, was already left behind by Ying Chanxi after running two straightaways.

"Three laps left," Li Luo prompted, keeping pace with Ying Chanxi.

When Ying Chanxi passed the stands where Class 1 was, the students from Class 1, led by Liu Shaowen and Xie Shuchen, shouted loudly to cheer her on.

Class 8 was not to be outdone. Led by Zhu Yufei, they cheered for Xiuxiu and Jin Yuting.

Especially Lin Yuan. When he shouted "Go Xiuxiu," he was practically screaming his lungs out, as if he wished he could run onto the track and carry her.

However, some girls were also muttering amongst themselves.

"It's one thing for the class president not to cheer for our own classmates, but why is he running alongside a girl from another class?"

"Exactly. He's our class president, after all."

"That girl is Ying Chanxi, you know."

"Who's Ying Chanxi?"

"The top student in our grade, the study god of Class 1."

"And she's the class president's cousin, right? Have you forgotten? She comes to our classroom after school every day to find him so they can go home together."

"No wonder."

"Why don't I have a cousin like the class president?"

"It's not too late for you to acknowledge Li Luo as your big brother now."

"Haha, acknowledge him as a 'good brother'?"

"Yeah, from now on, you'll be his 'good little sister'."

As they chatted, the topic went astray, and low laughter spread among the girls.

By now, Li Luo had already accompanied Ying Chanxi through the third lap.

Ying Chanxi had also smoothly moved to the front of the second tier.

Looking ahead.

Except for the one sports-focused student who was way ahead of everyone, there were only five or six people in front of Ying Chanxi.

"Assess your stamina," Li Luo said calmly, panting slightly. "On the last lap, you decide when you're ready to sprint!"

With Li Luo's plan, Ying Chanxi calmed down and ran forward silently.

When there was only half a lap of the race left, Ying Chanxi clenched her jaw and launched into her final sprint.

Li Luo immediately kept up with her, constantly prompting in her ear, "200 meters, 150 meters, 100 meters."

"The last 50 meters!"

"Hang in there!"

"Cross the line!"

"Go!"

With Li Luo's encouraging shouts, Ying Chanxi cleared her mind, her eyes fixed on the final goal.

After overtaking several people, she pushed forward with all her might and finally dipped her head as she crossed the finish line!

The moment she crossed the finish line, Ying Chanxi's legs suddenly felt weak, as if all the strength in her body had been drained, and she nearly collapsed to the ground.

Fortunately, Li Luo appeared beside her just in time.

In the end, completely out of strength, Ying Chanxi fell straight into Li Luo's arms.

(End of this chapter)
